verdict.rationale: Vestd's help docs describe Data rooms for storing and sharing important files in one secure, central place, where the company decides what to include (agreements, financials, cap tables, shareholder documents) and who gets access. That is a permissioned data room covering both cap table and underlying documents. missing for 10: detail on access controls (view-only, expiry, per-folder permissions), audit/activity logs for diligence, evidence that cap tables are live views rather than uploaded files, explicit counsel/investor sharing workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
